rationale: Closed bounded feasibility gives a nonempty compact domain. Expansion of the fixed quadratic objective bounds its difference by a finite coefficient times Euclidean distance; lower semicontinuity then gives attainment. The proof does not require invertibility or select a unique minimizer.
